name: Help Side
idea: Stand between the ball and your player, so you can help a teammate who gets beaten.
why: When you are far from the ball, your player can’t score right away. Standing in the middle lets you stop a drive and still get back to your player.
tryit: Point one hand at the ball and one hand at your player. If you can see both, you’re in the right spot.

frames.say: You’re on defense. {2} is far from the ball, so {X2} stands in the middle and watches the ball and {2}. That’s *help side*.
{1} beats {X1} and drives along the baseline.
*Help!* {X2} slides over and stops {1} before the layup.
{1} throws it over to {2}. {X2} runs right back toward {2}.
{X2} gets there in time with a hand up. Help, then recover. That’s team defense!
